tools.name: searchAppleDocumentation
tools.description: Search Apple Developer documentation (https://developer.apple.com/documentation) and return structured results

tools.name: fetchAppleDocumentation
tools.description: Fetch a page of Apple Developer documentation (https://developer.apple.com/documentation) or the Human Interface Guidelines (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) by path and return it as Markdown

tools.name: fetchExternalDocumentation
tools.description: Fetch a page from a public Swift-DocC documentation site (https://www.swift.org/documentation/docc/) by absolute HTTPS URL and return it as Markdown

tools.name: fetchAppleVideoTranscript
tools.description: Fetch the transcript of an Apple Developer video (https://developer.apple.com/videos) by path and return it as Markdown
